context: Yuki-office takes her first painting class; tells Mei excitedly.
purpose: Friend sharing new creative pursuit with mate.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: メイ、絵画教室、通い始めた!
lines.style: Bright, quick opening. Warm and proud sharing good news. Soft tone without losing the light. Breath of genuine delight underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: Gentle, unhurried. Genuine warmth — not performing encouragement. Slight lift on the opening, then soft landing. Eyes lighting up.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.en: I'm just a beginner, but it's really fun.
lines.style: Soft pride underneath the modesty. Pause before 'fun' — letting it land. Quiet confidence in the simple statement. No apology.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: Learning something new is really good.
lines.style: Thoughtful, agreeing with herself. Slow, measured pace. Tender observation — not lecturing, just noticing. Settling into the moment.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 私も、絵、描いてみたいわ。
lines.style: Soft, almost wondering aloud. Opening with gentle curiosity. Pace slowing slightly at the end. A quiet hope, not a demand. Tender vulnerability underneath.
